# RojMitra by EarlyJobs

> RojMitra is a village-level workforce intelligence initiative by EarlyJobs.
> It is designed to organise consent-based information about worker location,
> occupation, skills, employment experience, availability and work journeys in
> India.

## Entity Notes
- RojMitra is an initiative by EarlyJobs.
- RojMitra is not a government programme.
- Demonstration worker profiles or dashboards on the website should not be
  interpreted as national coverage metrics.
- Verification status should be interpreted according to the specific
  evidence and process used for each record.
